faults.title: Manual clutch action problems
faults.description: On some third-generation manual MINI hatches, the clutch hydraulics or pedal return spring can cause trouble. Check that the pedal returns smoothly and have any sticking or inconsistent action inspected.

faults.title: Gear linkage jumping out of gear
faults.description: A worn or misadjusted linkage can make a third-generation MINI jump out of gear. During a test drive, check that each gear stays engaged and have the linkage adjusted or repaired if it does not.
